dedupe_keys.name: eia refinery capacity report capacity of every operable us petroleum refinery form eia 820

description: The Refinery Capacity Report of the U.S. Energy Information Administration gives the capacity of US petroleum refineries from Form EIA-820, the Annual Refinery Report. The edition read, with data for 1 January 2026, was released on 26 June 2026, with the next due in June 2027, and previous issues go back to 1994. Data series include fuel, electricity and steam purchased for consumption at refineries, refinery receipts of crude oil by method of transportation, and current and projected atmospheric crude oil distillation, downstream charge and production capacities of selected products. Respondents are all operating and idle refineries including new ones under construction, non-refinery operators of distillation, reforming, cracking, coking and hydrotreating, and refineries shut down in the previous year, located in the 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands, Guam and other possessions. A spreadsheet gives capacity by individual refinery, with tables by PAD district and state. Files are Excel and PDF, free to download; as US government works they are in the public domain and EIA asks for acknowledgement. Caveats: capacity is a yearly snapshot, not throughput. Simulation uses are refinery inventories for fuel supply models and hurricane and flood exposure of Gulf Coast refining. Related records: data-jodi-oil-world-database gives monthly refinery intake and output by country.
